body:
Resumes S202-24 (paused mid-flight, last session): stdlib/expr.prn's parse-expr/EvalError/coerce-num/coerce-str now real (recursive-descent arithmetic/string/variable-binding evaluator, awk's own coercion rules), stdlib/awk.prn's run-rules gaps fixed (missing &, arity, join-fields/concat-field-name). tests/test_awk.c compiles gcc-clean against a freshly-regenerated tests/test_awk_gen.c (parena build over string/array/io/regex-syntax/regex-pcre/expr/awk.prn) and passes all 10 checks: expr/eval arithmetic/concat/coercion/variable-binding, and awk/run's real read-split-match-evaluate pipeline over a 2-line file end to end. Added 'make test-awk' (matching test-json/test-yaml's own discipline) -- deliberately NOT a turboawk CLI target, since expr.prn's expression language has no print/output primitive yet; a real, honest turboawk binary isn't buildable until that's designed and added, flagged rather than faked. Full core suite (336 tests) and turbogrep/turbosed both reverified still clean -- no regressions. PARENA commits 8a5fcdd + a8ab931.

⚓ ☃
title: turboawk dogfooding finished — tests/test_awk.c 10/10 PASS
